coverage.label: Fund custody / depositary
coverage.definition: Named custody or depositary appointment for the reviewed fund's assets. Investor-wallet support and the custody of an underlying fund are not inherited.

coverage.label: Fund administration
coverage.definition: Explicit fund administrator or accounting/administrative agent. A NAV calculation agent or token administrator alone does not qualify.

coverage.label: Transfer agency
coverage.definition: Explicit transfer-agent appointment or delegation. A platform or distribution relationship alone does not qualify.

coverage.label: Token / share-record infrastructure
coverage.definition: Named tokenization platform, token administrator, vault developer or share-register operator, with the exact function retained. These functions are not equivalent services.
